Application.Text2:
protocols:
protocol_id: P1
name: 固定、预处理、透化和封闭
sample_scope: 全部28份已取得新鲜胆管组织
source_locators: 
  [1]     source_id: S1
    block: 3
    detail: 
steps: 
  [1]     stage: initial_fixation
    operation: 组织浸入甲醇/DMSO
    conditions: 80% methanol/20% DMSO; temperature not_reported
    duration_original: overnight
    time_role: stage_duration
    uncertainty: 
  [2]     stage: PFA_fixation
    operation: 次日转入PFA
    conditions: 4% PFA; 4°C
    duration_original: 24 h
    time_role: stage_duration
    uncertainty: 
  [3]     stage: pre_dehydration
    operation: 甲醇梯度脱水
    conditions: 50%,80%,90%各一次；100%三次
    duration_original: not_reported per wash
    time_role: stage_duration
    uncertainty: 随后句写4°C孵育60min，未明确是否指每次脱水
  [4]     stage: post_dehydration_incubation
    operation: 按原文保留脱水后孵育
    conditions: 4°C; medium/individual-wash scope ambiguous
    duration_original: 60 min
    time_role: stage_duration
    uncertainty: 不能将60min分配到前述每个梯度
  [5]     stage: DCM_preprocessing
    operation: 二氯甲烷/甲醇孵育
    conditions: 66% dichloromethane/33% methanol; room temperature
    duration_original: overnight
    time_role: stage_duration
    uncertainty: 原文66+33=99%，不补成67/33
  [6]     stage: methanol_wash
    operation: 100%甲醇清洗两次
    conditions: 100% methanol
    duration_original: not_reported
    time_role: stage_duration
    uncertainty: 
  [7]     stage: bleaching
    operation: 氧化内源色素和自发荧光蛋白
    conditions: methanol with 5% hydrogen peroxide;4°C
    duration_original: overnight
    time_role: stage_duration
    uncertainty: 
  [8]     stage: rehydration
    operation: 甲醇递减复水
    conditions: 90%,80%,50% methanol
    duration_original: not_reported
    time_role: stage_duration
    uncertainty: 
  [9]     stage: PBS_wash
    operation: PBS清洗一次
    conditions: PBS
    duration_original: not_reported
    time_role: stage_duration
    uncertainty: 
  [10]     stage: detergent_wash
    operation: 含Triton的PBS洗两次
    conditions: 1×PBS/0.2% Triton X-100
    duration_original: 1 h each
    time_role: stage_duration
    uncertainty: 
  [11]     stage: permeabilization
    operation: 透化
    conditions: 1×PBS/20% DMSO/0.2% Triton X-100/0.3 M glycine;37°C
    duration_original: 2 days
    time_role: stage_duration
    uncertainty: 
  [12]     stage: blocking
    operation: 封闭
    conditions: 1×PBS/0.2% Triton X-100/10% DMSO/6% donkey serum;37°C
    duration_original: 2 days
    time_role: stage_duration
    uncertainty: 
whole_workflow_time: not_reported; includes three overnight steps and unreported washes
